notes.title: Patch 1.1
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45056326/685a30307c1a4a28e7c28a04ee2559be4bdd0e6f.png[/img]

[h1][b]Bugfixes:[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug where the mouse cursor was not visible.
[/list]
The game now starts in windowed mode instead of fullscreen, which should help resolve this issue.

If you are affected by this issue, try changing the settings from fullscreen to windowed mode and then back to fullscreen. This should resolve the problem.

Feel free to leave feedback in the comments. Alternatively, I can remove the custom mouse cursor.
